name: spec-factory-oracle
description: Read-only factory-first planning chain: spec, factory design, then oracle review. Does not run factory_run.

steps.task: Convert goal into a factory-ready spec for repeated work: {goal}. Preserve original ask: {original_user_ask}.

steps.expectedOutcome: factory.v1 with manifest, schema, validators, smoke/pilot, sentinel, and resume/checkpoint strategy
